article.title: Inflammation, Hypoxia, and Periodontal Breakdown: The Association Between Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Periodontitis; Results From a Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis.
article.authors: Esperouz F, Lorusso M, Giannini GR
article.abstract: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between obstructive sleep apnea and periodontitis and to quantify the magnitude of this relationship based on the available evidence.
